quests.instruction: Adding a silent e to “cap” makes “cape”. What happens to the vowel sound?
quests.hint: Say cap and cape one after the other. Listen to the vowel.
quests.explanation: In “cape”, the silent e makes the a say its name, the long a sound. The e itself stays quiet.
quests.funFact: Teachers sometimes call the silent e “magic e” because it changes the vowel without making a sound.

quests.instruction: Which word has the long a sound?
quests.hint: The long a sounds like the letter’s name: ay.
quests.explanation: “Tape” has long a because of the silent e. “Tap” and “tab” have short a.

quests.instruction: Add a silent e to “mad”. Which word do you make?
quests.hint: Put the e on the end and say the new word.
quests.explanation: “Mad” plus a silent e becomes “made”. The vowel changes from short a to long a.

quests.instruction: Which word has the long a sound, like “cake”?
quests.hint: Look for an a, a consonant, and a silent e.
quests.explanation: “Game” follows the a_e pattern, so it has long a. “Gap” has short a and “gum” has short u.
quests.funFact: Long ago, the final e in words like game and lake was pronounced. Today it is silent.

quests.instruction: Which word does NOT have the long a sound?
quests.hint: Check the end of each word. Which one has no silent e?
quests.explanation: “Gate” and “lake” have the a_e pattern. “Crab” has short a.

quests.instruction: Which letter makes the vowel say its name in “snake”?
quests.hint: It is the silent letter at the end.
quests.explanation: The silent e at the end of “snake” makes the a say its name.

quests.instruction: Add a silent e to “kit”. Which word do you make?
quests.hint: Add one letter to the end and read the new word.
quests.explanation: “Kit” plus e becomes “kite”. The vowel changes from short i to long i.
quests.funFact: Kit and kite, bit and bite, pin and pine: adding a silent e changes the vowel sound.

quests.instruction: Which word has the long i sound?
quests.hint: The long i sounds like the letter’s name: eye.
quests.explanation: “Bike” has the i_e pattern, so the i is long.

quests.instruction: Which word has short i, not long i?
quests.hint: Look for a word with no silent e on the end.
quests.explanation: “Fin” has short i. “Five” and “fine” end with a silent e, so their i is long.

quests.instruction: Which word has the long o sound?
quests.hint: Long o sounds like its own name: oh.
quests.explanation: “Bone” has the o_e pattern, so the o is long. “Box” and “bog” have short o.
quests.funFact: Bone, hole, nose, home and rope all follow the o_e pattern.

quests.instruction: Add a silent e to “not”. What word do you make?
quests.hint: Add the e and say the new word aloud.
quests.explanation: “Not” plus e makes “note”, with the long o sound.

quests.instruction: Which vowel sound do you hear in “home”?
quests.hint: Say home slowly. Does the vowel say its name?
quests.explanation: “Home” has the long o sound, spelled with the o_e pattern.

quests.instruction: cub → cube. Which word has the long u sound, like “you”?
quests.hint: Long u says its name: yoo.
quests.explanation: “Cute” has the u_e pattern, so it has long u. “Cut” and “cup” have short u.

quests.instruction: Add a silent e to “tub”. Which word do you make?
quests.hint: Add the e to the end and say the word.
quests.explanation: “Tub” plus e makes “tube”. “Tuba” is a different word, since it adds an a.

quests.instruction: Which word has the long e sound spelled e_e?
quests.hint: Look for an e, a consonant, and a silent e.
quests.explanation: “These” has the e_e pattern. “Then” and “them” have short e.
quests.funFact: The e_e pattern is less common than a_e, i_e and o_e.

quests.instruction: Two of these words have a long a sound. Which word does not?
quests.hint: Say each word and listen to the vowel. Look at the endings too.
quests.explanation: “Hate” and “gate” have long a. “Hat” has short a.

quests.instruction: Which word has a long vowel?
quests.hint: Check the end of each word. Is there a silent e?
quests.explanation: “Slide” has the i_e pattern. “Slid” and “slip” have short i.

quests.instruction: Which word has a short vowel?
quests.hint: Look for the word with no silent e.
quests.explanation: “Rod” has short o. “Rode” and “robe” have the o_e pattern.
quests.funFact: Rod and rode are different words, and the silent e makes all the difference.

quests.instruction: Which vowel pattern completes the word? sk_t_ — you glide on ice with these.
quests.hint: Say each choice and see which one gives you a real word.
quests.explanation: “Skate” uses the a_e pattern, with the long a sound.

quests.instruction: Which vowel pattern completes the word? sm_k_ — it rises from a fire.
quests.hint: Sound out each choice and listen for a real word.
quests.explanation: “Smoke” uses o_e, with long o.

quests.instruction: Which vowel pattern completes the word? fl_t_ — a musical instrument you blow into.
quests.hint: Say each choice slowly. Which one makes the instrument word?
quests.explanation: “Flute” uses u_e. The u says its name, “yoo”, but after l it sounds like “oo”.
quests.funFact: After the letter l, long u often sounds like /oo/ instead of /yoo/, as in flute and rule.

quests.instruction: Which pair shows a short vowel turning into a long vowel with a silent e?
quests.hint: Look for the pair where one word has an extra e.
quests.explanation: “Rob” becomes “robe” when you add a silent e. The vowel changes from short o to long o.

quests.instruction: “Plane” ends with a silent e. How many sounds does it have?
quests.hint: The silent e does not make a sound. Count only the sounds you can hear.
quests.explanation: “Plane” has 4 sounds: /p/ /l/ /a/ /n/. The e stays silent.
quests.funFact: Plane and plain sound exactly the same but are spelled differently.

quests.instruction: Which word has the long i sound and ends in silent e?
quests.hint: Say each word. Which one has the vowel that says its name?
quests.explanation: “Smile” has long i with the i_e pattern. “Smell” and “skill” have short vowels.

quests.instruction: Which word says /g/ /r/ /ā/ /p/ and names a fruit that grows in bunches?
quests.hint: Add the right ending to make the vowel say its name.
quests.explanation: “Grape” uses the a_e pattern for long a. “Gripe” has long i.

quests.instruction: Which word is read /sh/ + long i + /n/?
quests.hint: Look at the end of each word for a silent e.
quests.explanation: “Shine” has the i_e pattern, so the i is long. “Shin” has short i and “shone” has long o.

quests.instruction: Which word has the long u sound, as in “mule”?
quests.hint: Say each word. Which one has a vowel that says its name?
quests.explanation: “Huge” uses u_e for long u. “Hug” and “hut” have short u.
quests.funFact: Huge and mule both use u_e, and the long u can sound like “yoo”.

quests.instruction: Which word has the same vowel sound as “nine”?
quests.hint: Say nine slowly and listen to the vowel. Match it.
quests.explanation: “Nine” and “time” both have long i. “Tin” has short i and “tan” has short a.

quests.instruction: Which word does NOT have a long vowel?
quests.hint: Look for the silent e in each word.
quests.explanation: “Cave” and “cube” both have a silent e. “Cap” has short a.

quests.instruction: Which word turns into a new word when you add a silent e?
quests.hint: Add an e to each word and decide whether you get a real word.
quests.explanation: “Hop” becomes “hope”. “Hum” and “hot” do not become words when you add e.
quests.funFact: Hop becomes hope, cap becomes cape, tub becomes tube and kit becomes kite with a silent e.
